domains.name: Customer Relationship Management
domains.capability: run campaigns, capture and qualify leads, progress opportunities through pipeline stages with quotes and contracts, and resolve service cases
domains.benefit: marketing, sales, and service share one forecastable, auditable view of every customer relationship
domains.workflow: Run campaign → capture lead → qualify → open opportunity → advance pipeline stage → quote → close won → sign contract
domains.statefulEntity: Opportunity (pipeline stages: lead → qualified → proposal → won/lost)

domains.name: Customer Value Management
domains.capability: score customer value, churn, and propensity, match products and pricing to segments, and deliver next-best-action offers with measured uplift
domains.benefit: marketing, pricing, and retention decisions are evidence-based and grow revenue per customer
domains.workflow: Ingest events → score value and churn → segment → match products and pricing → decide next best action → deliver treatments → measure uplift vs control

domains.name: Enterprise Resource Planning
domains.capability: integrate procure-to-pay, order-to-cash, inventory, and general-ledger accounting across the enterprise
domains.benefit: finance and operations work from a single, auditable source of enterprise truth
domains.workflow: Create requisition → approve → raise purchase order → receive goods → three-way match invoice → pay vendor → post to ledger

domains.name: Human Capital Management
domains.capability: maintain employee records, org structure, leave requests, and payroll inputs
domains.benefit: HR and managers handle workforce changes with consistent approvals
domains.workflow: Onboard employee → assign position → submit leave → approve → reflect in payroll
domains.statefulEntity: LeaveRequest (submitted → approved → rejected → reflected in payroll)

domains.name: Supply Chain Management
domains.capability: coordinate suppliers, inventory levels, fulfillment orders, and shipments
domains.benefit: supply chain teams resolve stock-outs and delays before they hit customers
domains.workflow: Forecast demand → place supplier order → receive inventory → fulfill customer order → ship

domains.name: Warehouse Management System
domains.capability: control bin locations, pick lists, stock levels, receipts, and outbound shipments
domains.benefit: warehouse staff pick and ship orders accurately and on time
domains.workflow: Receive stock → put away → allocate pick list → pick → pack → ship

domains.name: Transportation Management System
domains.capability: plan carriers, routes, loads, and freight rates for deliveries
domains.benefit: logistics teams reduce cost while meeting delivery commitments
domains.workflow: Create shipment → plan route and load → assign carrier → track stops → confirm delivery

domains.name: Order Management System
domains.description: Order Management System with industry specialization.
domains.capability: ingest orders from channels, allocate inventory, fulfill, and handle returns
domains.benefit: operations teams fulfill omnichannel orders without manual reconciliation
domains.workflow: Receive order → allocate inventory → pick and pack → ship → process return if needed

domains.name: Product Lifecycle Management
domains.capability: manage product revisions, bills of material, and engineering change orders
domains.benefit: engineering and manufacturing build from approved product definitions
domains.workflow: Create part → define BOM → submit engineering change → review → release revision

domains.name: Product Information Management
domains.description: Product Information Management with industry specialization.
domains.capability: maintain product attributes, categories, catalogs, and channel publications
domains.benefit: merchandising teams publish accurate product data everywhere it is sold
domains.workflow: Create product → enrich attributes → assign category → publish to catalog channel

domains.name: Master Data Management
domains.description: Master Data Management with industry specialization.
domains.capability: govern golden records, hierarchies, match rules, and data stewardship tasks
domains.benefit: the organization trusts one authoritative master for each data domain
domains.workflow: Ingest source record → match and merge → steward review → publish golden record

domains.name: Business Process Management
domains.capability: run process definitions, human tasks, cases, and SLA-tracked workflows
domains.benefit: teams execute repeatable processes with visible bottlenecks and escalations
domains.workflow: Start case → assign tasks → complete forms → decision gateway → close case

domains.name: Governance, Risk & Compliance
domains.capability: track controls, risks, policies, audit findings, and remediation evidence
domains.benefit: compliance teams prove adherence and close gaps before audits
domains.workflow: Assess risk → map control → collect evidence → record finding → remediate

domains.name: Enterprise Asset Management
domains.capability: maintain assets, work orders, maintenance plans, and spare parts
domains.benefit: reliability teams reduce downtime through planned maintenance
domains.workflow: Register asset → schedule preventive maintenance → create work order → complete → update meter reading

domains.name: Manufacturing Execution System
domains.capability: execute shop-floor work orders, batches, routings, and quality checks
domains.benefit: production supervisors see real-time status across work centers
domains.workflow: Release work order → start batch at work center → record production → perform quality check → complete
domains.statefulEntity: WorkOrder (released → in progress → quality check → complete)

domains.name: Quality Management System
domains.capability: manage inspections, non-conformances, CAPA, and product specifications
domains.benefit: quality teams contain defects and prevent recurrence
domains.workflow: Schedule inspection → record sample → raise non-conformance → initiate CAPA → verify effectiveness

domains.name: Content Management System
domains.capability: author content, manage pages and media, and publish through approval workflows
domains.benefit: editors ship approved content to the right channels on schedule
domains.workflow: Draft content → review → approve → publish page → archive or update

domains.name: Business Intelligence & Analytics
domains.description: Business Intelligence & Analytics with industry specialization.
domains.capability: define datasets, metrics, dashboards, and reports for decision-makers
domains.benefit: leaders monitor KPIs without waiting for ad hoc analysis
domains.workflow: Model dataset → define metric → build dashboard → share report → refresh on schedule

domains.name: IT Service Management
domains.capability: log incidents, manage changes, track configuration items, and meet SLAs
domains.benefit: IT support restores service quickly with traceable change history
domains.workflow: Log incident → diagnose → link configuration item → resolve → close with SLA met

domains.name: Learning Management System
domains.capability: publish courses, manage enrollments, deliver lessons, and issue certificates
domains.benefit: learners progress through structured training with measurable outcomes
domains.workflow: Publish course → enroll learner → complete lessons → pass assessment → issue certificate

domains.name: Configure, Price, Quote
domains.capability: configure products, apply price rules, bundle offers, and generate customer quotes
domains.benefit: sales reps quote complex deals accurately without spreadsheet errors
domains.workflow: Select product → configure options → apply pricing rules → generate quote → submit for approval

domains.name: Financial Management System
domains.description: Financial Management — GL, AP, AR, subledgers & close
domains.capability: manage the chart of accounts, general ledger, accounts payable and receivable, sales and purchase subledgers, payments, and period close
domains.benefit: finance teams post, reconcile, and close books with auditable GL-to-subledger traceability
domains.workflow: Post to GL → record AP/Purchase Ledger invoice → approve payment → post AR/Sales Ledger receipt → reconcile subledgers → close fiscal period

domains.name: Credit & Collections Management
domains.capability: set credit limits, monitor exposure, score risk, and manage collections cases
domains.benefit: finance teams reduce bad debt while keeping good customers trading within policy
domains.workflow: Onboard account → assign credit limit → monitor exposure → flag breach → open collection case → resolve

domains.name: Lease Management System
domains.capability: manage lease contracts, leased assets, payment schedules, renewals, and escalations
domains.benefit: real estate and finance teams stay compliant with lease terms and accounting standards
domains.workflow: Create lease contract → link asset → schedule payments → track renewal → amend or terminate

domains.name: Financial Technology Platform
domains.description: Financial Technology Platform with industry specialization.
domains.capability: process transactions, maintain ledgers, and enforce financial controls
domains.benefit: stakeholders trust balances and audit trails in real time
domains.workflow: Initiate transaction → validate limits → post to ledger → reconcile → audit

domains.name: Digital Commerce & Retail
domains.capability: browse a catalog of physical, digital, and service products, manage carts, checkout with promotions, pay, and track fulfilment from shipping to instant provisioning
domains.benefit: shoppers complete purchases of goods and services with visibility into order status
domains.workflow: Browse catalog → add to cart → checkout → apply promotion → pay → fulfill order → confirm delivery

domains.name: Point of Sale System
domains.capability: ring up sales, apply tenders, manage register shifts, and print receipts
domains.benefit: store staff checkout customers quickly with accurate cash control
domains.workflow: Open shift → scan items → apply tender → print receipt → close shift and reconcile
domains.statefulEntity: Sale (open shift → items scanned → tendered → receipt printed)

domains.name: Electronic Health Records
domains.capability: manage patients, appointments, medical records, and prescriptions
domains.benefit: clinicians coordinate care with complete patient context at the point of service
domains.workflow: Register patient → schedule appointment → document visit → prescribe → follow up
